final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), stats AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_invoices, AVG(count) as avg_count, COUNT(*) as num_states FROM state_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT BillingState, count FROM state_counts WHERE count > (SELECT avg_count FROM stats)) SELECT SUM(above_avg.count) as total_invoices, AVG(CAST(above_avg.count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_invoices FROM stats)) as avg_share, AVG(above_avg.count) - (SELECT avg_count FROM stats) as avg_above_average FROM above_avg
